name.full: Project name. This name will be used as the docker container's name too.

pythonEnv.full: Add python dependencies for your project. These are general dependencies, and will be used with any target (CPU/GPU/QPU) selected.

target.full: Select the target hardware for your Q8S project. Choose CPU for standard processing, GPU for accelerated computing, or QPU for quantum processing units. Ensure your environment is set up to support the selected target.

dockerUsername.full: Docker registry username. This is used for pushing and pulling the necessary docker images and containers.

kubernetesConfig.full: Selected file will be used as the kubeconfig file. This file handles the kubernetes orchestration.

workspacePath.full: Selected directory will be used as the workspace (root directory) for the project.
